creators.name: Keiichi Matsuda
creators.role: Designer and filmmaker; founder of Liquid City
creators.bio: Architect-trained designer and filmmaker whose speculative AR films (Augmented City, HYPER-REALITY, Merger) became the reference images of what an overlaid city could feel like. He later led design at Leap Motion and founded the XR/AI studio Liquid City.
creators.why: HYPER-REALITY is arguably the most-cited piece of critical AR design fiction ever made.

creators.name: Julian Oliver
creators.role: Critical engineer and artist
creators.bio: New Zealand-born artist and co-author of the Critical Engineering Manifesto, working with networks, surveillance and 'improved reality'. His early AR works used hacked binoculars and marker-tracked cubes to question who owns the view.
creators.why: The Artvertiser (2008) is one of the first artworks to use AR to take back public visual space from advertising.

creators.name: Nobumichi Asai
creators.role: Technical and creative director (WOW / Asai studio)
creators.bio: Japanese visual artist who pioneered real-time face-tracking projection mapping, painting moving digital makeup onto performers' faces with near-zero latency.
creators.why: OMOTE and INORI turned the human face into a live, tracked AR canvas years before phone face filters.

creators.name: Bot & Dolly
creators.role: Robotics and film studio (acquired by Google, 2013)
creators.bio: Studio that repurposed industrial robot arms for film motion control. With director Bradley 'GMUNK' Munkowitz they made Box, a live performance of projection mapping onto robot-moved surfaces shot in-camera.
creators.why: Box showed projection mapping synchronised with robots and camera as a new 'in-camera' mixed-reality language.

creators.name: Daito Manabe / Rhizomatiks
creators.role: Artist, programmer and DJ; co-founder of Rhizomatiks
creators.bio: Daito Manabe and Rhizomatiks (with Motoi Ishibashi and choreographer MIKIKO / ELEVENPLAY) build live shows that mix drones, projection, motion capture and AR broadcast, including Perfume's stage shows and the Rio 2016 Tokyo handover.
creators.why: They made AR a live-performance medium, from mixed-reality wheelchair dance (border) to AR sports broadcasts (Fencing Visualized).

creators.name: Universal Everything (Matt Pyke)
creators.role: Digital art and design studio founded by Matt Pyke
creators.bio: Matt Pyke's studio makes digital lifeforms, crowds and walking figures for galleries, brands and architecture, increasingly as camera-driven mirrors and AR apps that let audiences see themselves transformed.
creators.why: Future You and Chameleon turned motion-capture mirrors into poetic, public-facing mixed-reality portraits of the viewer.

creators.name: Acute Art
creators.role: AR/VR art production platform (director Daniel Birnbaum)
creators.bio: Production studio and app that commissions blue-chip artists (Olafur Eliasson, KAWS, Marina Abramović, Precious Okoyomon and others) to make AR sculptures placeable anywhere through a phone.
creators.why: Acute Art brought AR into the contemporary-art canon at museum and global public-space scale.

creators.name: Tamiko Thiel
creators.role: Media artist; co-founder of Manifest.AR
creators.bio: Pioneering VR/AR artist (and designer of the Connection Machine CM-1/CM-2) who uses geolocated AR to insert political and ecological 'what-ifs' into specific sites, from the Venice Biennale to the Whitney.
creators.why: A founding figure of AR public art whose site-specific interventions span 15 years.

creators.name: John Craig Freeman
creators.role: Artist; professor at Emerson College; Manifest.AR founding member
creators.bio: Public artist who uses geolocated AR to build memorials and stories in real landscapes, most famously marking migrant deaths along the US-Mexico border.
creators.why: Border Memorial showed AR as a tool for memorialising the invisible at the exact place it happened.

creators.name: Mark Skwarek
creators.role: Artist; NYU Mobile AR Lab director; Manifest.AR co-founder
creators.bio: AR activist-artist behind unauthorised AR interventions such as 'The Leak in Your Hometown', which turned every BP logo into a gushing oil pipe during the 2010 spill.
creators.why: He made marker-based AR a medium of protest and culture jamming.

creators.name: Sander Veenhof
creators.role: AR artist; co-organiser of 'We AR in MoMA'
creators.bio: Dutch artist who has staged uninvited AR interventions since 2010 (MoMA, Venice Biennale) and now prototypes playful social experiments for AR glasses.
creators.why: His guerrilla 'We AR in MoMA' show launched AR as a medium for occupying institutions without permission.

creators.name: Nancy Baker Cahill
creators.role: Artist; founder of the 4th Wall AR app
creators.bio: Artist who builds monumental drawn AR sculptures and sited public artworks (Desert X, Liberty Bell) through her free 4th Wall app.
creators.why: She uses AR to make large-scale, politically charged public art that needs no permit or plinth.

creators.name: Jeremy Bailey
creators.role: Artist, 'Famous New Media Artist'
creators.bio: Canadian performance artist who has used webcam tracking and AR since the mid-2000s to satirise the art world and tech industry with deadpan software demos.
creators.why: His AR performances made camera-based AR a comic, self-aware art form before the ARKit wave.

creators.name: Theo Triantafyllidis
creators.role: Artist working with games, simulation and mixed reality
creators.bio: Greek-born artist whose live simulations and mixed-reality performances (Anti-Gone, All My Confusing Pets) blur performer, avatar and game engine.
creators.why: He treats mixed reality as a stage for absurd, feral performance rather than utility.

creators.name: Sutu (Stuart Campbell)
creators.role: Artist, comic creator and XR director
creators.bio: Australian comic artist and XR director whose Modern Polaxis was one of the first AR comic books, later known for Tilt Brush work and XR art at festivals and museums.
creators.why: Modern Polaxis made printed comics come alive through the phone camera in 2014.

creators.name: James Alliban
creators.role: Media artist and AR developer
creators.bio: One of the first artists to make webcam AR widely shared online (2009's AR business card), later building Kinect installations and co-creating CELL with Keiichi Matsuda.
creators.why: His Flash-era AR experiments showed millions what marker-based AR could feel like before smartphones.

creators.name: Nexus Studios
creators.role: Film, animation and interactive studio
creators.bio: Oscar-nominated animation studio whose interactive arm made some of the best-known narrative AR apps for Google, the BBC and The New Yorker.
creators.why: They brought character animation craft to phone AR, from HotStepper wayfinding to BBC Civilisations AR.

creators.name: Pablo Valbuena
creators.role: Artist working with light, space and time
creators.bio: Spanish artist whose 2007 'Augmented Sculpture' at Ars Electronica fused projected light with physical geometry, a founding work of art projection mapping.
creators.why: He named and defined 'augmented' sculpture and space with projection before the term was mainstream.

creators.name: Joanie Lemercier (AntiVJ)
creators.role: Visual artist; co-founder of the AntiVJ label
creators.bio: French artist who co-founded AntiVJ and pioneered projection mapping on architecture and on drawn landscapes, later turning to environmental activism.
creators.why: His projections on line drawings (Eyjafjallajökull, FUJI) made light itself look like matter.

creators.name: teamLab
creators.role: Art collective (founded by Toshiyuki Inoko)
creators.bio: Interdisciplinary art collective building room-scale interactive projection worlds where visitors' drawings and bodies change the artwork.
creators.why: Sketch Aquarium made 'your drawing comes alive in the room' a mass-audience mixed-reality experience.

creators.name: Moment Factory
creators.role: Multimedia entertainment studio
creators.bio: Studio known for architectural projection mapping, illuminated night walks (Lumina) and interactive projected play spaces worldwide.
creators.why: They scaled projection AR to cathedrals, forests and arenas as public storytelling.

creators.name: The Heavy Projects (B.C. Biermann)
creators.role: AR public art studio; Re+Public
creators.bio: B.C. 'Heavy' Biermann's studio behind Re+Public, which animated large street murals and billboards with AR from the early 2010s.
creators.why: Early, large-scale AR street art that reclaimed urban surfaces.

creators.name: Studio DRIFT
creators.role: Artist duo Lonneke Gordijn and Ralph Nauta
creators.bio: Dutch studio known for kinetic and drone light works; made one of the first gallery mixed-reality artworks for HoloLens.
creators.why: Concrete Storm used spatial MR to make viewers physically feel virtual architecture.

creators.name: Marina Abramović
creators.role: Performance artist
creators.bio: The 'grandmother of performance art', who worked with Acute Art (Rising, VR) and Tin Drum (The Life, mixed reality) to extend presence into virtual bodies.
creators.why: The Life was billed as the first mixed-reality performance artwork sold at auction.

creators.name: Kimchi and Chips
creators.role: Art studio of Mimi Son and Elliot Woods
creators.bio: Korean-British duo working with light fields, projection and robotic mirrors to make images that occupy real space.
creators.why: Light Barrier made projected light hang in mid-air as volumetric drawings.

works.title: Augmented (hyper)Reality: Domestic Robocop
works.description: A first-person walk through a kitchen where every surface is covered in AR labels, recipes, ads and reward points; the film imagines how an 'augmented' home would be monetised.
works.idea_zh: 把家里每个平面都变成广告与界面，预演被信息淹没的增强生活

works.title: Augmented City 3D
works.description: A stereoscopic film of a walk through a city whose AR layers can be customised, shared and hijacked, questioning who designs the augmented urban space.
works.idea_zh: 城市空间变成可订阅、可定制的AR图层，每个人看到不同的城市

works.title: CELL (with James Alliban)
works.description: An interactive installation where a depth camera tracks visitors and attaches floating identity tags drawn from social media to their bodies on a large mirror-screen.
works.idea_zh: 摄像头追踪人体，给每个路人实时贴上网络身份标签的数字镜子

works.title: HYPER-REALITY
works.description: A POV short in Medellín where a woman's view is saturated with AR ads, game points and assistant UI; when her identity is hacked the overlay collapses.
works.idea_zh: 当AR完全接管视野，现实被游戏化与广告化后的眩晕与脆弱

works.title: Merger
works.description: A 360-degree film of an office worker whose entire workspace is a floating AR interface, controlled by hand and voice, as she fights to stay relevant against automation.
works.idea_zh: 未来白领被全息工作界面包围，用手势对抗AI取代的焦虑

works.title: Reality Channels (Liquid City)
works.description: A prototype of the 'real-world metaverse' in which users switch between channels that re-skin the same street with different AR layers, characters and information.
works.idea_zh: 像换电视频道一样切换城市的AR皮肤

works.title: Agents (Liquid City)
works.description: A short film where AI agents appear as characters in AR glasses and negotiate a person's day, asking what kind of relationship we want with AI in mixed reality.
works.idea_zh: 把AI助手具象为住在AR眼镜里的角色，思考人与智能体的关系

works.title: Wisp World (Liquid City)
works.description: An AR/AI game for Snap Spectacles and Vision Pro where the player talks with a small spirit character, Wisp, who explores and comments on the real room.
works.idea_zh: 与会说话的小精灵在真实房间里冒险的AI+AR游戏

works.title: Project Jade - Spatial Agents (Liquid City)
works.description: A spatial AI agent for AR glasses that sees what the wearer sees and responds with embodied, placed UI, shown at Snap Lens Fest 2025.
works.idea_zh: 能看见你所见、在空间中回应你的AI伙伴

works.title: The Artvertiser
works.description: Custom binoculars recognise street billboards and replace each advert live with an artwork, turning advertising space into an exhibition surface.
works.idea_zh: 用改装望远镜把街头广告实时替换成艺术作品

works.title: levelHead
works.description: A spatial memory game: tilting a real cube with printed markers moves a tiny character through rooms that appear inside the cube on screen.
works.idea_zh: 手中的方块里藏着多个房间，转动实物方块来引导小人

works.title: OMOTE
works.description: Real-time face tracking and projection mapping paint shifting digital makeup, cracks and masks onto a model's moving face.
works.idea_zh: 把人脸变成实时追踪的投影画布，数字妆容随表情移动

works.title: connected colors
works.description: Face-tracked projection mapping blooms plants, birds and patterns across a performer's face in sync with her movement.
works.idea_zh: 花鸟纹样在追踪的面孔上实时绽放

works.title: Kacho-fugetsu
works.description: Seasonal Japanese motifs of flowers, birds, wind and moon are projected onto a moving face using real-time tracking.
works.idea_zh: 花鸟风月四季意象投映在活动的人脸上

works.title: INORI (Prayer)
works.description: Dancers AyaBambi's faces are mapped with high-speed projection (1000 fps tracking) so skulls, tears and eyes follow their fast choreography.
works.idea_zh: 千帧级高速追踪投影，让面部图像跟上激烈舞蹈

works.title: Dockyard 3D Projection Mapping / Yokohama Odyssey
works.description: Large-scale 3D projection mapping in the historic stone dry dock of Yokohama, turning the dock walls into an animated voyage.
works.idea_zh: 把百年石砌船坞变成航海史诗的投影舞台

works.title: Box
works.description: Two industrial robots move large panels while projection-mapped imagery on them stays locked to a robot-moved camera, creating illusions shot entirely in-camera.
works.idea_zh: 机械臂移动画布与摄像机，投影与运动精确同步的现场魔术

works.title: Nosaj Thing 'Eclipse/Blue' music video
works.description: A dancer performs inside real-time projected graphics driven by motion capture, so the visuals wrap her body and the space live.
works.idea_zh: 动作捕捉驱动的投影随舞者身体实时变形

works.title: Perfume at Cannes Lions
works.description: Perfume perform in white costumes that become projection screens, with tracked projection mapping splitting and multiplying their bodies on stage.
works.idea_zh: 服装即屏幕，追踪投影让偶像身体分裂和变形

works.title: Seamless MR (hanacam test)
works.description: A test of seamless mixed-reality video where a tracked camera composites CG into a live scene in real time.
works.idea_zh: 追踪摄像机把CG无缝合成进实景的MR实验

works.title: border (Rhizomatiks Research x ELEVENPLAY)
works.description: Audience members ride automated wheelchairs wearing headsets whose view mixes live dancers with virtual ones, so they cannot tell which bodies are real.
works.idea_zh: 坐着自动轮椅戴头显，真假舞者在眼前交错

works.title: drone + AR test
works.description: Tests where flying drones are tracked and AR graphics are composited onto them in real time, previewing AR for live drone performances.
works.idea_zh: 给飞行中的无人机实时叠加AR图形

works.title: Fencing Visualized
works.description: An AR sports-broadcast system that tracks the tips of fencing swords and draws their trajectories over live footage so audiences can follow the fast bouts.
works.idea_zh: 把剑尖轨迹实时叠加在直播画面上，让看不清的击剑变得可见

works.title: live AR system test
works.description: A test of a live AR system for stage shows, with virtual graphics anchored to the physical stage as the broadcast camera moves.
works.idea_zh: 舞台直播中虚拟图形与真实舞台锁定的实时AR系统

works.title: discrete figures (with Kyle McDonald)
works.description: A dance performance mixing dancers, drones, projection and machine-learning 'generated dancers' that appear alongside and on the performers.
works.idea_zh: 机器学习生成的虚拟舞者与真人同台

works.title: Squarepusher 'Terminal Slam' music video
works.description: Through mixed-reality glasses, Shibuya's billboards and ads are erased and replaced by glitching visuals synced to the music (diminished reality).
works.idea_zh: 戴上MR眼镜，涩谷的广告被抹去并替换成音乐视觉

works.title: 1000 Hands
works.description: Visitors contribute line drawings through a mobile app; each drawing is grown into a 3D form that joins a collective, evolving projected landscape in the gallery.
works.idea_zh: 上千名观众的手绘被生长成立体形态，汇入共同的投影风景

works.title: Future You
works.description: A motion-capture mirror that turns each viewer into a synthetic robotic figure; the harder you move, the stranger its 47,000 possible responses become.
works.idea_zh: 照见'未来的你'的动捕镜子，越动越奇异

works.title: Super You (AR app)
works.description: An iPhone AR app that tracks your body and transforms you into a flowing digital being in real time.
works.idea_zh: 手机一扫，把自己变成流动的数字生命体

works.title: HyperSpace AR
works.description: A LiDAR-based AR app for iPhone 12 / iPad Pro that fills your room with generative forms that respond to the scanned walls and furniture.
works.idea_zh: 用LiDAR扫描房间，让生成形态沿真实表面生长

works.title: Infinity
works.description: A generative installation of endlessly evolving digital beings; the interactive version lets visitors' presence and movement influence the figures on screen.
works.idea_zh: 观众的出现改变无尽行走的人群

works.title: Look Up - Augmented Reality Architecture
works.description: AR experiments that attach digital sculptures and animated beings to building facades, inviting people to look up at architecture.
works.idea_zh: 在建筑立面上长出AR雕塑，邀请人们抬头看城市

works.title: Chameleon
works.description: A camera-driven digital being that mimics passers-by's movement and appearance, shown on screens in East London streets, malls and later Venice and Beijing.
works.idea_zh: 街头会模仿你的数字变色龙生物

works.title: Hydrogen Wave
works.description: An interactive space at Hyundai Motorstudio Senayan Park, Jakarta, where visitors' movements send waves through a large projected field of animated particles themed on hydrogen energy.
works.idea_zh: 用身体推动'氢能'粒子之浪

works.title: Prototype: Someone - a random mirror
works.description: A mirror prototype that reflects the viewer's pose but replaces them with a randomly generated other person.
works.idea_zh: 镜子里照出的永远是'别人'

works.title: Ultrasound for Apple Vision Pro
works.description: An immersive piece for Apple Vision Pro in which pulsing ultrasound-like forms emerge and surround the viewer (headset work; largely immersive).
works.idea_zh: 把超声波般的生命形态带进Vision Pro的空间

works.title: Olafur Eliasson: WUNDERKAMMER
works.description: A collection of AR objects by Olafur Eliasson (a sun, rain cloud, rainbow, puffin, compass) placed in the viewer's home during lockdown; the AR sun even charges a virtual Little Sun lamp.
works.idea_zh: 疫情期间把太阳、云、彩虹等自然现象用AR带进家里

works.title: KAWS: Expanded Holiday
works.description: KAWS's giant COMPANION figure released as AR sculptures placed simultaneously in cities worldwide and in users' homes, sold as limited AR editions.
works.idea_zh: 全球同时出现的巨型AR玩偶雕塑，也可买回家

works.title: Unreal City
works.description: An AR public art walk along London's Thames with 36 works by artists such as Olafur Eliasson, Cao Fei and Tomás Saraceno, curated with Dazed.
works.idea_zh: 泰晤士河畔的AR雕塑步道

works.title: Art Critic Face Matrix (We AR in MoMA)
works.description: Part of the uninvited AR show in MoMA: a matrix of critics' faces floats in the galleries, visible only through the Layar browser.
works.idea_zh: 在MoMA内部未经许可放置批评家面孔矩阵

works.title: Shades of Absence: Public Voids
works.description: Geolocated AR at the Venice Biennale placing golden silhouettes of censored artists in public squares.
works.idea_zh: 在威尼斯公共空间放置被审查艺术家的金色剪影

works.title: Newtown Creek (oil spill)
works.description: Geolocated AR on Brooklyn's Newtown Creek visualising the huge hidden oil spill beneath it.
works.idea_zh: 让地下看不见的石油泄漏浮现在河面上

works.title: Carnation Rain (Largo do Carmo)
works.description: An AR rain of red carnations over Lisbon's Largo do Carmo, where the 1974 Carnation Revolution ended.
works.idea_zh: 在革命发生的广场上空下起AR康乃馨雨

works.title: Gardens of the Anthropocene
works.description: AR plants mutated by climate change (such as giant red algae) grow over real harbours and gardens.
works.idea_zh: 气候变化下变异的植物在真实港湾里生长

works.title: Evolution of Fish
works.description: An AR artwork of fish evolving into plastic-bag creatures; here the artist plays with video feedback in the AR view.
works.idea_zh: 鱼在AR中进化成塑料袋生物

works.title: Enter the Plastocene
works.description: An AR/VR installation where plastic waste creatures swim through the exhibition space around visitors, shown at MEET Milan.
works.idea_zh: 塑料生物在展厅中游动的塑料纪

works.title: Border Memorial: Frontera de los Muertos
works.description: Geolocated AR skeletal effigies (inspired by Día de los Muertos) mark the exact places where migrants died crossing the US-Mexico border.
works.idea_zh: 在移民死亡的确切地点放置AR亡灵纪念碑

works.title: Orators, Rostrums and Propaganda Stands
works.description: Virtual orators' podiums, inspired by early Soviet agitprop, are placed in public squares via AR for anyone to 'speak' from.
works.idea_zh: 在公共广场放置可发声的AR演讲台

works.title: Climate Change Migration Stories AR
works.description: Life-size volumetric AR portraits of people displaced by climate change appear in public space and tell their own stories.
works.idea_zh: 气候移民以真人大小的AR形象现身讲述自己的故事

works.title: The Leak in Your Hometown
works.description: Point a phone at any BP logo and an AR broken pipe gushes oil out of it, bringing the Deepwater Horizon spill to your own street.
works.idea_zh: 对准任何BP标志，都会喷出AR原油

works.title: Warcraft ARmor
works.description: A marker-based AR demo that dresses the user's body in World of Warcraft-style armour on screen.
works.idea_zh: 把游戏盔甲穿到真人身上

works.title: We AR in MoMA
works.description: An uninvited AR exhibition inside MoMA New York: artworks by Manifest.AR members were geolocated into the galleries and visible only via the Layar app.
works.idea_zh: 不请自来，用AR在MoMA里开了一场展览

works.title: Subway PONG
works.description: A playful AR glasses experiment: a game of Pong played across a real subway carriage with fellow passengers.
works.idea_zh: 在地铁车厢里用AR眼镜打乒乓

works.title: Distant Hand
works.description: A hand-tracked AR prototype that extends your hand far into the space in front of you to touch distant objects.
works.idea_zh: 伸出一只能触到远方的AR长手

works.title: Multi-person AR fashion
works.description: Real-time AR garments dress several people at once, exploring shared digital fashion on the street.
works.idea_zh: 多人同时穿上AR数字时装

works.title: Urban Lasergame AR
works.description: A location-based AR laser tag game played in city streets.
works.idea_zh: 把城市街道变成AR激光枪战场

works.title: AI style transfer on live AR camera
works.description: Live AI style transfer applied to an AR glasses camera, turning the surroundings into a painting in real time.
works.idea_zh: 用AI把眼前世界实时变成画作

works.title: 4th Wall (app and Contested Landscapes)
works.description: Monumental drawn sculptures by the artist appear in galleries and public sites through her free 4th Wall AR app.
works.idea_zh: 用免费App让巨型手绘雕塑出现在任何地方

works.title: Revolutions / Margin of Error (Desert X)
works.description: Geolocated AR sculptures in the Coachella Valley desert for Desert X, including a writhing mass of drawn lines rising over a landfill site.
works.idea_zh: 沙漠中缠绕升起的巨型AR线条雕塑

works.title: Liberty Bell
works.description: A giant AR Liberty Bell rings over historic US sites (Philadelphia, Selma, Washington) as a call to civic action.
works.idea_zh: 在美国历史地点上空敲响AR自由钟

works.title: Siren Songs
works.description: An animated, immersive AR public artwork for Elevation 1049 in Gstaad and St. Moritz: drawn forms float in the Alpine landscape with a sung soundtrack.
works.idea_zh: 阿尔卑斯山间会唱歌的AR声音雕塑

works.title: Video Terraform Dance Party
works.description: A webcam performance where the artist's body movements sculpt a 3D landscape around him live on screen.
works.idea_zh: 用舞蹈动作在屏幕中塑造地形

works.title: Nail Art Museum
works.description: An AR 'museum' that places tiny artworks and gallery spaces on the artist's fingernails, parodying the art market.
works.idea_zh: 把美术馆缩小搬到指甲上

works.title: Dropping an Ai Weiwei Urn in AR
works.description: The artist re-enacts Ai Weiwei's famous urn-dropping photo with a virtual urn in AR.
works.idea_zh: 用AR重演艾未未摔瓮

works.title: ARt
works.description: A deadpan performance-demo (for TEDxTheWrong) launching 'the world's first platform for augmented reality art', satirising AR hype with face- and body-tracked artworks.
works.idea_zh: 一本正经地演示AR艺术的荒诞

works.title: Studio Visit (mobile portal)
works.description: A site-specific mixed-reality installation: a mobile AR portal opens from the gallery into a surreal virtual version of the artist's studio.
works.idea_zh: 手机AR传送门通往艺术家的怪诞工作室

works.title: All My Confusing Pets
works.description: A mixed-reality performance where the artist interacts with glitchy virtual pets composited into the real space.
works.idea_zh: 与一群混乱的虚拟宠物同台的混合现实表演

works.title: Anti-Gone
works.description: A live mixed-reality performance (Sundance 2020) where a motion-captured performer drives an ork-like avatar through a simulated swamp in real time.
works.idea_zh: 动捕表演者实时驱动虚拟生物的沼泽剧场

works.title: Modern Polaxis
works.description: A printed comic about a paranoid time-traveller; pointing a phone at each page brings panels to life with animation, sound and 3D depth.
works.idea_zh: 用手机扫描实体漫画，每一页都活了起来

works.title: Augmented Reality Business Card
works.description: Holding up his printed business card to a webcam makes a 3D video of the artist pop out of it and introduce himself.
works.idea_zh: 举起名片，名片上弹出会说话的3D本人

works.title: Augmented Reality Ribbons
works.description: Marker-tracked AR where flowing 3D ribbons spill out of a printed marker and follow its movement, reacting to music.
works.idea_zh: 从标记中涌出、随音乐飘动的AR丝带

works.title: Wallpaper* Augmented Reality issue
works.description: A set of webcam AR pieces for Wallpaper* magazine's AR issue, bringing printed pages to life with animated 3D artworks.
works.idea_zh: 让设计杂志的纸页在摄像头前长出3D作品

works.title: Traces
works.description: An interactive artwork using a Kinect camera that reflects visitors as trails of light, turning movement into drawings.
works.idea_zh: Kinect把观众的动作变成光的轨迹

works.title: HotStepper
works.description: The first AR character-based wayfinding app: enter any address and an animated character walks ahead of you through the real street to lead the way.
works.idea_zh: 一个AR小人走在你前面为你带路

works.title: The New Yorker Innovators Issue AR Cover (with Christoph Niemann)
works.description: Christoph Niemann's New Yorker cover of a subway platform opens in AR into a 3D Manhattan that rises out of the magazine.
works.idea_zh: 杂志封面上的地铁站升起整座立体曼哈顿

works.title: BBC Civilisations AR
works.description: An AR app with BBC R&D that places over 30 museum artefacts in your room, which you can inspect, x-ray and hear narrated.
works.idea_zh: 把博物馆文物搬进客厅，还能透视观察

works.title: Childish Gambino Playmoji (Google Pixel)
works.description: A dancing AR Childish Gambino character for Pixel's Playground that reacts to the user and dances alongside people in the camera view.
works.idea_zh: 会和你同框跳舞的AR明星

works.title: 1600: White House AR (dollar bill)
works.description: Point a phone at a US one-dollar bill to see a 3D White House rise from it and experience a year in the life of 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue.
works.idea_zh: 一美元钞票上长出立体白宫

works.title: Changdeok ARirang
works.description: A location-based AR tour of Seoul's Changdeokgung palace with animated guides and historical stories anchored to the grounds.
works.idea_zh: 在昌德宫里由AR角色讲述历史

works.title: Notable Women
works.description: With Google and former US Treasurer Rosie Rios, the app puts portraits of historic American women onto US banknotes in AR.
works.idea_zh: 用AR把杰出女性的头像印到美元上

works.title: Back to the Moon AR
works.description: An AR version of the Emmy-nominated Google Spotlight Story about Georges Méliès, letting the animated film play out on your table.
works.idea_zh: 梅里爱的月球奇遇在桌面上AR重演

works.title: Augmented Sculpture v1.2
works.description: A white geometric sculpture is overlaid with precisely mapped projected light, so edges, planes and shadows appear to move, fold and rebuild the physical form.
works.idea_zh: 用精确投影让静止的白色体块产生时空变形

works.title: Augmented Space (The Hague City Hall)
works.description: Architectural projection on The Hague city hall that traces and animates the building's own structural lines.
works.idea_zh: 沿着建筑自身结构线投影，让市政厅立面'活'过来

works.title: Para-Site (Mattress Factory)
works.description: Site-specific video projection on the architecture of the Mattress Factory, with light that seems to crawl along corners and surfaces.
works.idea_zh: 寄生在建筑角落上的光线投影

works.title: re-flex (Z33)
works.description: A projected light installation for Z33 that reveals and distorts the geometry of the room, discussed by the artist.
works.idea_zh: 光线揭示并扭曲房间几何的装置

works.title: AntiVJ - projection on building
works.description: An early experiment projecting live visuals onto a building and playing with its existing architecture, a seed of the AntiVJ label's mapping style.
works.idea_zh: 早期把实时视觉投到建筑上并与其结构互动的实验

works.title: AntiVJ - Grote Kerk
works.description: A live audiovisual projection performance on the interior of the Grote Kerk cathedral in Breda.
works.idea_zh: 在大教堂内部进行的现场投影表演

works.title: AntiVJ - SONGDO
works.description: An audiovisual projection performance on architecture in New Songdo City, South Korea.
works.idea_zh: 在韩国新松岛城建筑上的视听投影

works.title: Eyjafjallajökull
works.description: Light is projected onto a hand-drawn wireframe mountain so the drawing appears to erupt, shift and transform into a volcano.
works.idea_zh: 投影让手绘线稿山体仿佛火山喷发

works.title: FUJI
works.description: A 14-minute installation where projection over a large drawing of Mount Fuji creates shifting light, weather and geometric illusions.
works.idea_zh: 投影在富士山素描上营造光影与天气

works.title: Blueprint
works.description: A 15-minute audiovisual installation of projected light on a technical line drawing, exploring the blueprint as the origin of structures.
works.idea_zh: 光在蓝图线稿上建构与解构

works.title: Sketch Aquarium
works.description: Children colour paper fish that are scanned and immediately swim in a giant projected aquarium, where they react when touched.
works.idea_zh: 孩子画的鱼被扫描进投影水族馆里游动

works.title: Sketch Town
works.description: Hand-drawn cars, buildings and UFOs are scanned into a shared 3D projected town where they drive and fly, and can be touched.
works.idea_zh: 手绘的车与房子进入共享的投影城市

works.title: Flowers and People, Cannot be Controlled but Live Together
works.description: Projected flowers bloom and wither across the walls through the seasons; when visitors touch or stand still, petals scatter or grow around them.
works.idea_zh: 投影花朵因观众的触碰与停留而绽放或凋落

works.title: Graffiti Nature
works.description: Drawn animals and plants are scanned into a projected room-sized ecosystem where they eat each other and flee when visitors step on them.
works.idea_zh: 画出的动物进入会被踩、会捕食的投影生态

works.title: Sagrada Familia - Ode à la Vie
works.description: A monumental projection-mapping show on Gaudí's Sagrada Família façade for La Mercè festival, making the stone appear to grow, flood and bloom.
works.idea_zh: 让圣家堂石墙生长、涌流、开花的投影秀

works.title: Foresta Lumina
works.description: An illuminated night walk through a forest in Coaticook, Quebec, with projection, light and sound that tell a story along the trail.
works.idea_zh: 夜晚森林步道上的光影叙事

works.title: AURA
works.description: Projection mapping and light transform the interior of Montreal's Notre-Dame Basilica into an immersive audiovisual experience.
works.idea_zh: 把教堂内部变成沉浸式光影空间

works.title: Augmented Games
works.description: Motion-tracked floor and wall projection that turns any space into a physical video-game playground and sports court.
works.idea_zh: 把任何场地变成可以跑跳的投影游戏场

works.title: Re+Public AR mural
works.description: Re+Public's AR app animates large street murals: pointing a phone at the wall makes the painted characters and shapes come alive.
works.idea_zh: 对准街头壁画，画中形象立刻动起来

works.title: Concrete Storm
works.description: Commissioned by Microsoft and Artsy, a mixed-reality artwork on HoloLens where virtual concrete pillars appear in a real room and shift as the viewer walks between them.
works.idea_zh: HoloLens里的虚拟混凝土柱林随脚步变化

works.title: The Life
works.description: The first mixed-reality performance artwork: a 19-minute volumetric capture of Abramović appears in the room through an MR headset, walking within a marked circle.
works.idea_zh: 通过MR头显，艺术家的全息分身在你面前表演

works.title: Light Barrier
works.description: Projected light is reflected by 200 curved mirrors into haze, forming floating volumetric shapes that seem to exist in mid-air.
works.idea_zh: 镜面阵列把投影光折射进雾中，形成悬浮光体

leads.name: Simon Pyke (Freefarm)
leads.why: Sound designer and Matt Pyke's brother; long-time audio collaborator on Universal Everything works.

leads.name: Benjamin Millepied / L.A. Dance Project
leads.why: Choreographer whose motion-captured dancers drove Universal Everything's Presence and 1000 Hands era works.

leads.name: The Designers Republic (Ian Anderson)
leads.why: Sheffield studio where Matt Pyke worked before founding Universal Everything.

leads.name: Stanley Donwood / Radiohead PolyFauna
leads.why: Radiohead's PolyFauna app (with Universal Everything) is an early generative, camera/gyro-driven spatial art app.

leads.name: Bradley 'GMUNK' Munkowitz
leads.why: Director of Bot & Dolly's Box; projection and motion-control design.

leads.name: Romain Tardy
leads.why: AntiVJ co-founder; architectural projection works such as O (Omicron) in Wroclaw and The Drift.

leads.name: Yannick Jacquet (Legoman)
leads.why: AntiVJ co-founder working with projection on architecture and sculpture.

leads.name: Damian Stewart
leads.why: Co-developer of The Artvertiser's AR tracking; Berlin media artist.

leads.name: Danja Vasiliev
leads.why: Critical engineer; collaborator of Julian Oliver (Newstweek, reality-manipulation devices).

leads.name: Motoi Ishibashi / MIKIKO (ELEVENPLAY)
leads.why: Rhizomatiks co-founder and choreographer behind the drone/AR dance works.

leads.name: Will Pappenheimer
leads.why: Manifest.AR founding member making geolocated AR interventions.

leads.name: Christopher Manzione
leads.why: Manifest.AR member; AR sculptures in public space.

leads.name: Raymond Salvatore Harmon
leads.why: MIRAGE: architectural-scale painting that becomes an AR app.

leads.name: Marshmallow Laser Feast
leads.why: Immersive studio; mostly VR/installations, check for projection/MR pieces (Laser Forest, Meet Your Creator).

leads.name: Anna Zhilyaeva
leads.why: Live VR painter; work is VR not AR, but mixed-reality performances could qualify.

leads.name: Olafur Eliasson
leads.why: Could be his own creator entry: Wunderkammer (AR) plus Rainbow and other Acute Art works.

leads.name: KAWS
leads.why: Expanded Holiday AR and KAWS: New Fiction (Serpentine, 2022) AR/game show.

leads.name: Precious Okoyomon / The Looking Glass (The Shed)
leads.why: Acute Art AR group show at The Shed (2021) with Darren Bader, Alicja Kwade, Okoyomon and others.

leads.name: Rachel Rossin
leads.why: Artist working across VR/AR and painting; AR works to check.

leads.name: Kyle McDonald
leads.why: Co-created discrete figures with Rhizomatiks (covered by creative-coding cluster).

leads.name: Marlena Myles (Dakota Spirit Walk)
leads.why: Permanent AR public art honouring Dakota culture in St. Paul.

leads.name: Tin Drum
leads.why: Producer of Marina Abramović's The Life; mixed-reality art production.
